messages:
maria_gonzalez: Hi — trying to apply promo SPRINGBOOST2025 at checkout, getting "Promo code invalid or expired". The promo shows active in the marketing dashboard until 2025-06-01. Screenshot: https://redwood-share/IMG123.png

anna_support: Thanks — can you confirm the account email and org id? Also which flow are you using (dashboard apply / checkout / API)?

maria_gonzalez: Account: maria@acme-studio.com, org: acme-studio-prod. Using the web checkout (Stripe flow). Tried incognito and mobile, same error.

james_billing: Pulling ledger/ledger-redeem logs for that code now... one sec.

james_billing: quick snippet from the redemption attempt logs: error="max_redemptions_exceeded" code=SPRINGBOOST2025 redeemed=250 limit=250 user_email=maria@acme-studio.com request_id=req_f8c2

james_billing: Looks like the promo hit its global cap (250). The marketing dashboard still shows it as "active" — UI doesn't reflect exhaustion. That would make the API return invalid/expired.

emily_ops: Confirmed via promo table: name=SPRINGBOOST2025 start=2025-04-01 end=2025-06-01 max_uses=250 redeemed_count=250. We can either increase max_uses or issue a one-off manual credit to this org. @anna_support recommend manual credit to unblock onboarding.

anna_support: Please issue manual credit of $50 and tag audit. Also open a ticket for marketing to decide whether to bump cap. Maria — we'll apply a $50 credit to your account and follow up here within 24h. Sorry for the confusion.

maria_gonzalez: Thank you — really trying to get the team onboarded today so appreciate the quick help.

promo-bot: ACTION_LOG: manual_credit_created id=MC-89234 amount=50 currency=USD target_org=acme-studio-prod created_by=emily_ops ts=1765001255

james_billing: Created internal ticket BILL-4782 to ask marketing to review cap and to push a UI fix so exhausted promos surface as "Exhausted" instead of "Active".

anna_support: Closing loop here — maria, you should see the $50 credit within ~15 mins. If it doesn't appear, ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
